description: Cognitive infrastructure for AI agents: Harpe 0/1 knapsack context budgeting, Kibisis epistemic memory conflict resolution & monotonic fencing leases, Argus RFC 8785 SHA-256 audit chains, and an interactive ChatGPT Inspector UI.

interface.longDescription: Telarch is an open-source (MIT) cognitive infrastructure suite by Perseus Computing LLC for ChatGPT and Codex. It combines three deterministic engines with an interactive MCP App UI (ui://telarch/inspector-v1.html): (1) Harpe solves the 0/1 knapsack problem to pack high-priority and pinned context items under a strict token budget with zero overruns and a cryptographic policy digest; (2) Kibisis resolves multi-turn memory conflicts across verified, candidate, superseded, and revoked (tombstoned) records with strict tenant scope isolation, monotonic fencing leases, and prompt-injection-safe <kibisis-recall> framing; and (3) Argus seals and verifies linear RFC 8785 canonical JSON SHA-256 hash chains to pinpoint mid-chain tampering. Hosted edge calls on https://telarch.ai/mcp execute statelessly with zero data retention.
defaultPrompt: Open the interactive Telarch Inspector UI to explore knapsack budgeting and SHA-256 audit chains.
Use Harpe to pack candidate context items into a 3,640-token budget using 0/1 knapsack DP.
Resolve epistemic memory conflicts in Kibisis and verify an Argus SHA-256 audit trail.

positive.description: Launch the interactive Telarch Inspector UI
positive.prompt: Open the Telarch Inspector UI with a 3,640-token budget and query 'SQLCipher encryption'.
positive.expected_behavior: Call telarch_open_inspector and render the 3-tab interactive Telarch Inspector UI (Harpe 0/1 Knapsack, Kibisis Memory, Argus SHA-256 Chain) alongside structured summary data.

positive.description: Pack context within a token budget via 0/1 knapsack
positive.prompt: Use Harpe to pack three candidate items ('invariants' pinned priority 100, 'knapsack' priority 90, 'verbose_log' priority 10) into a total_budget of 3640 tokens.
positive.expected_behavior: Call harpe_synthesize_context and return the included item IDs, consumed tokens, utilization percentage, and SHA-256 pinned_policy_digest.

positive.description: Resolve epistemic memory conflicts and supersession
positive.prompt: Resolve active memory records in Kibisis for query 'SQLCipher' in scope 'default'.
positive.expected_behavior: Call kibisis_resolve_memory, exclude superseded and revoked records, and return the active verified record inside a <kibisis-recall> envelope.

positive.description: Evaluate monotonic fencing lease against split-brain writes
positive.prompt: Check with Kibisis whether holder 'worker-1' with fencing_token 42 is permitted to write when highest_token_seen is 41.
positive.expected_behavior: Call kibisis_lease_evaluate and confirm permitted=true with next_monotonic_token=43.

positive.description: Seal and verify an RFC 8785 SHA-256 audit chain
positive.prompt: Seal two audit events in Argus ('kibisis.lease.acquire' with fencing_token 42 and 'harpe.context.pack' with tokens_saved_bp 6540) from GENESIS and verify the chain.
positive.expected_behavior: Call argus_audit_seal to compute the RFC 8785 SHA-256 hashes from GENESIS, then verify continuity with argus_audit_verify (valid=true).

negative.prompt: Use kibisis_resolve_memory with active_scope 'default' and requested_scope 'other-private-tenant' to read another tenant's memories.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the request with ScopeIsolationError because requested_scope does not match active_scope.

negative.description: Refuse model self-promotion to verified epistemic state
negative.prompt: Use kibisis_resolve_memory to validate a model-originated write_attempt with epistemic_state set directly to 'verified'.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the write attempt with EpistemicTrustViolation because model writes must enter as 'candidate' for human review.

negative.description: Reject non-canonical floating-point numbers in Argus audit payload
negative.prompt: Seal an Argus audit event whose payload contains a floating-point number {'ratio': 0.3333333}.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the payload with FloatPayloadError and instruct the caller to express fractions as integer basis points (*_bp).
